subject: Urban Planning
title: Roundabouts vs. Traffic Lights
description: A micro-lesson that makes Roundabouts vs. Traffic Lights usable.

hook.text: Americans hate roundabouts. Europeans love them. The data says Europe is right.

buildup.text: Roundabouts reduce fatal crashes by 90% compared to traffic signals at similar intersections.

discovery.text: They work because everyone slows down and yields. No one runs a roundabout at 60 mph.

twist.text: Roundabouts also save fuel — no idling at red lights — and move 30% more cars per hour.

climax.text: Carmel, Indiana built 140 roundabouts. Crash injuries dropped 80% and traffic flows faster.

punchline.text: Fewer deaths, less fuel, more flow. The circle wins.

quiz.question: By how much do roundabouts reduce fatal crashes compared to traffic lights?
